stem.text: Compound J, $\text{C}_{15}\text{H}_{23}\text{Br}_2\text{Cl}$, is reacted with an excess of a hot concentrated solution of sodium hydroxide in ethanol. One of the products is $X$.

stem.alt: Reaction scheme, labelled compound J: a bicyclic ring compound with two Br atoms and one Cl atom, a methyl-substituted ring and an exocyclic =CH2 group, drawn on the left, then an arrow labelled excess NaOH in ethanol, then X on the right.

stem.text: What could be the skeletal formula of $X$?

A.alt: Skeletal formula of a bicyclic ring compound with a gem-dimethyl carbon, a C=C double bond in each ring, a methyl group on the right ring, and an exocyclic =CH2 group.

B.alt: Skeletal formula of a bicyclic ring compound with a methyl group, two C=C double bonds, and an exocyclic =CH2 group.

C.alt: Skeletal formula of a bicyclic ring compound with a methyl group, one C=C double bond in each ring, and an exocyclic =CH2 group.

D.alt: Skeletal formula of a bicyclic ring compound with a gem-dimethyl carbon, a C=C double bond in one ring, a methyl-substituted C=C in the other ring, and an exocyclic =CH2 group.
